text:
maria: Quick sync — need final decisions on PRD scope, launch criteria, and fallback routing for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. Target: cut scope by Friday EOD.
jamal: Can you summarize the customer-driven asks again? which customers are blocking on this?
sophia: Primary asks: 1) deterministic embedding versioning for search relevance, 2) rerank as a hosted endpoint (low cost) or client-side SDK option, 3) chat streaming + function-calls with predictable latency.
maria: Correct. Also a few enterprise customers need explicit fallback policies (no silent failures).
alex: For tradeoffs — we can do a stronger SLA by reserving capacity (Dedicated) but cost increases. Alternative: best-effort hosted with transparent fallbacks to cheaper model variants.
nate: Proposal: default hosted path -> if p95 latency > 500ms or error rate >1% route to fallback model/region. Customer tiers control which fallback they get.
sophia: Acceptance criteria draft (quick):
```
- Chat/completions: streaming enabled, function-calls supported, p95 token latency <= 300ms on CI load (50conns).
- Embeddings: pinned model version returned in response, vector size fixed, round-trip <= 120ms for single request.
- Rerank endpoint: returns list of ids + score float, supports top_k param, degrades to score-less ids with client-side ordering guidance when unavailable.
- All: clear error codes + telemetry for failover path.
```
jamal: That looks good. A few edge cases: what if embeddings change dims after a rollout? we need a migration path and a hard reject if client sent old dim.
maria: Agreed — add an explicit 400 with message: "embedding_dim_mismatch" and a migration doc link.
alex: For rerank, we should support a minimal stateless mode that returns score=0 and explain in docs how to do client-side tie-breaks. That keeps latency low for best-effort mode.
sophia: Also define rollout gating: canary on 1% of traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with regression checks on quality and latency. If quality drop > 3% for a key customer slice, auto-roll back.
nate: Operational hooks: need per-route tracing, token-level cost reports, and a quick toggle to force fallback per-customer. Ops should own the toggle UI.
maria: Edge cases list to include in PRD:
- partial streaming disconnects (resume token behavior)
- embeddings shape mismatch (reject vs. best-effort normalization)
- rerank timeouts mid-request (stream 0 scores + ids)
- function-call errors in chat (bubble error to caller with error_type)

jamal: Can we draft minimal API examples in the spec? e.g. rerank request body and expected response with scores + types.
sophia: I'll paste a quick example below: 
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{ "model": "redwood-rerank-v1", "query": "q...", "items": [ {"id":"1","text":"..."} ], "top_k": 10 }

Response:
{ "model": "redwood-rerank-v1", "results": [{"id":"1","score": 0.873}], "warnings": [] }
```
alex: Nice. For launch criteria I suggest:
- Implementation: API + SDK samples + docs
- Tests: perf (latency/cost), regressions (quality on benchmark prompts)
- Observability: traces, per-route cost, alerting for p95 breaches
- Security: token scoped for rerank/embeddings, no plaintext logs for inputs

maria: Prioritization: If we must cut scope, drop hosted advanced rerank features (adaptive reranking) from initial launch and ship basic rerank + client guidance. Customers still get emb version pinning and chat streaming first.
jamal: Sounds reasonable. Which customers should we inform about scope cut? list: AcmeSearch, FinServe, DocuCorp.
sophia: I'll draft the PRD section marking those customers as stakeholders and the acceptance tests we run with them.
deploy-bot: New RFC draft uploaded: https://internal.redwood/rfcs/238-prd-fallback-routing (uploaded by sophia) :pushpin:
maria: Nice — can everyone review the RFC by Thursday morning? we want to finalize gating rules and the exact error codes.
alex: I'll review latency gating and fallback model mappings.
nate: Ops will prototype the per-customer toggle UI and a simple toggle API by Thu EOD.
jamal: I'll update the roadmap ticket with the scope decision and send a short note to the three customers.
sophia: Will add the embedding migration plan and sample client error handling examples.
maria: OK — action items: sophia (PRD + RFC edits), alex (perf gating + fallback mappings), nate (toggle prototype), jamal (customer comms). Review complete by Thu 9am PT. :thumbsup:
